description: After every part is sent: pass each part's number and the ETag header storage answered. The server checks them against what storage holds (same checksum, right length, nothing missing), assembles the file and marks it ready. A part that doesn't check out is named; send it again and call this again.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: media_multipart_complete
title: Finish a resumable upload
